page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr7.12xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 48 dedicated physical cores and 48 vCPUs, utilizing the Intel Xeon 8369HB processor running at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The instance is configured with a 1.0 thread-per-core ratio, meaning hyperthreading is disabled, ensuring dedicated compute resources per vCPU. It is equipped with 384.0 GB of RAM, providing 8.0 GB of memory per core.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for operating system and data storage needs. Network connectivity is delivered via a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and high memory-to-core ratio offer a predictable performance profile for memory-intensive workloads without the resource contention risks associated with shared-core or multi-threaded environments.

Given its 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated physical cores, the ecs.hfr7.12xlarge is designed for memory-optimized workloads. It is suitable for high-performance databases, in-memory caching layers, enterprise applications, and data processing tasks that require consistent CPU performance and substantial memory capacity without GPU acceleration.
